Implement default request body size limit for actions

- Set default maximum request body size for action requests to 33,554,432 bytes.
- Allow configuration of this limit globally via `app_config.action.max_request_body_bytes` or per app using CLI commands.
- Enhance error handling for request body size exceeding the limit.

Enhance HTTP plugin with request context and timeout support

- Updated `http.in` requests to inherit the current request context.
- Introduced an optional `timeout` argument for requests, defaulting to 300 seconds.
- Implemented automatic cleanup of unread response bodies through deferred plugin cleanup.
Updated to utilize system.CleanRelativePath for improved path handling.
Added unsafe prefix in property name for admin_over_tcp
Implement canonical URL for unknown domains fallback during app authentication
Use X-Forwarded-Proto when trusted for url generation
Strip auth headers before forwarding to app

Add OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics support

  Implement configurable OTLP HTTP telemetry setup with service/resource
  attributes, trace batching, metric export, secret-resolved headers, shutdown
  flush, and async exporter error logging.

  Instrumentation includes:
  - public HTTP/HTTPS and UDS server spans, with public app traffic filtered out
    of the outer otelhttp wrapper to avoid raw URL leakage
  - app request spans that honor audit skip/redact settings
  - Starlark handler and template render spans
  - optional plugin-call spans behind telemetry.plugin_spans
  - outbound HTTP transport wrapping for trusted internal clients
  - SQL driver duration histograms for sqlite/pgx
  - container manager duration histograms

  Also adds sample Grafana dashboards.
